name: Ketoconazole 1% Soap 75g Inventive Keto Medicated Soap
description:
Ketoconazole 1% Soap 75g Inventive Keto Medicated Soap 
Usage/Application: Fungal infections of the skin such as ringworm 
Item Name : Ketozax 
To treat and prevent fungal infections like dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis 
Infection of the hair root 
Increased production of tears 
Unusual hair loss or thinning 
Dry skin, rash, burning sensation 
Change in the texture of hair 
Acne 
Irritation of eyes 
Flaking skin 
Altered taste 
Allergic reaction (swollen face, lips, mouth, tongue, or throat which may cause trouble in swallowing or breathing) 
Severe skin irritation or reddening on the applied area 
Worsening of your condition or no improvement after regular use as directed
